h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Singrauli

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Singrauli

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Singrauli

c: Coal mines and power stations shape life in Singrauli, and many families live in company townships with their own parks, schools and sports grounds. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Singrauli for these townships, and for municipal parks and colleges in the district. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,140 km away, and send it to Madhya Pradesh by road.

Township buyers usually work through a tender or a purchase process with clear specifications. We can provide machine details, warranty terms and a layout drawing with each station and its clear space marked, so your engineering team has what it needs. After approval we manufacture, dispatch and install through our team or a dealer in central India.

richText.heading: Outdoor gyms for an industrial township

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,140 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you provide specifications for a township tender?
items.a: Yes. We can share machine details, materials, warranty terms and a layout drawing for the site. Contact our sales team with the tender requirements and site details.

items.q: How do we manage dust around the machines?
items.a: Install them on a paved or rubber-floored base and sweep the area often. Wipe the moving parts and have bearings checked every few months by the maintenance staff.

items.q: Can shift workers use the equipment safely at night?
items.a: The machines themselves need no supervision, but the area should be well lit. Plan lighting along the gym edge when you prepare the base. Machines with simple, visible movements are also easier to use safely in low light.
